literal_meaning: উচ্চ শব্দ বা আঁতাত (clatter or racket sound)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কাজের সময় যত টঙ্ক করে, কিছুই করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He makes so much fuss during work but achieves nothing.
The children are creating a commotion while playing.
note: Often used in phrases like 'টঙ্ক করা' to imply empty bluster or agitation without action.
